kinds.d: Dead, dried skeleton of a coral. Living coral is not sold here; fossil coral is under Fossil coral. Stony corals are CITES Appendix II.

x.d: Branching Acropora skeleton of aragonite; Atlantic staghorn is IUCN Critically Endangered.
Maze-patterned stony coral skeleton, such as Diploria labyrinthiformis.
Genus of table, elkhorn and staghorn corals, over 149 species.

kinds.d: Dried, emptied shell (test) of a sea urchin.

x.d: Flat Clypeasteroida test, 80–100 mm; bleached tests wash ashore.
Cidaroid urchin with thick blunt spines; spines sold as 'pencils'.
Oval irregular urchin test, such as Echinocardium.

kinds.d: Dried whole starfish (sea star) kept as a specimen. A fossil starfish is under Echinoderm fossil; craft assortments are in Craft & Art Supplies.

x.d: Asteroidea, about 1,900 species, usually five arms, dried for display.
Ophiuroidea with disc 3–150 mm and slender arms up to 60 cm.

notes: Sea fan (gorgonian) kept as a type since no Wikipedia page was retrieved for it. Old sources kept for the three planned kinds. Urchin archetypes sourced to the Sea urchin article. Colour-form and grade axes noted in dt.
